title: Record refused dones as work rows
goal: A backlog.py done that exits non-zero leaves a work row with action refused, from whichever hook event the research found carries it.

gates.question: Which exit codes of a backlog.py done write a refused work row: any non-zero exit, or exit 1 only (backlog.py's refusal code; 2 is bad usage, 127 and 9009 a missing interpreter)?
options: any non-zero exit with an Exit code N first line

gates.question: A done joined to another command that fails (done ID && make, cd x && done ID) exits non-zero: write a refused row anyway (same parser as the success path), or only when the done is the command's last piece?
options: write refused for any piece position
write refused only when the done is the last piece
gates.recommendation: write refused for any piece position
gates.answer: write refused for any piece position
